document_summary: The document outlines a proposed automation system designed to convert lengthy PDFs into clean, brand-compliant PowerPoint presentations. The primary goal is to significantly reduce manual presentation creation effort while strictly maintaining brand assets, fonts, layout, and overall PPTX quality. The workflow encompasses user PDF upload, text extraction, AI-powered summarization and slide outline creation, and template-based content generation. A dedicated PPTX builder assembles the final presentation using approved templates, ensuring brand consistency, editability in PowerPoint, and strict preservation of design elements. The system supports large documents, integrates with Next.js for the UI, n8n for backend processes, and Google Drive for storage, with a default target of 10 slides.

key_messages: The system automates the conversion of long PDFs into editable, brand-compliant PowerPoint presentations.
It prioritizes efficiency, strict brand control (fonts, logos, layout), and high-quality, editable output.
AI is leveraged for intelligent content summarization and slide outline generation.
A controlled, JSON-based template library ensures consistent design and messaging.
Brand assets (logos, icons) are strictly protected and never replaced by generated images.
The final PPTX is fully editable in PowerPoint, preserving all design integrity.
